scope: Dated community-practice source review across the existing 16 foundation layers. Selection refers to named guidance files or discovery roles, not whole-repository runtime acceptance.

merit_criteria.maintenance: Current canonical repository, dated head, archived flag and selected source files; popularity is not a score.
merit_criteria.fit: A concrete gap or duplicated incumbent responsibility determines adoption.
merit_criteria.native_compatibility: Supported skill/agent/plugin surfaces, actual tool authority and current primary Claude guidance.
merit_criteria.evidence: Source review, installation, discovery, native task output and comparative performance are separate. Reuse existing scoped receipts.
merit_criteria.cost: Prefer two on-demand skill files to whole catalogs/hooks/services; record bytes and added surfaces without inventing token or dollar savings.

candidates.role: Selected on-demand research and context-retrieval skills
candidates.rationale: Use only pinned search-first and iterative-retrieval to extend the existing project deployment to the native user skill surface. Existing canonical rules continue to bound delegation, validation, side effects and repeat work.
candidates.installation_mechanism: Supported skill directories or ECC plugin/installer; only two standalone skill directories are selected. Full plugin hooks, rule packs and the evaluation framework are not selected.
candidates.activation_status: Existing project skill copies matched the selected source. The coordinator separately reported successful global installation of both exact files and native Claude symlinks; runtime discovery remains pending independent/raw review. No skill task-performance trial occurred in this review.
limitations: The plugin manifest is version 2.2.2 and enables its local hooks by default; a full plugin install is broader than the selected change.
verification-loop includes generic 15-minute reruns, an 80% coverage target and raw grep-output examples; these do not override task-scoped validation and secret-output rules.
eval-harness is a useful guide but its candidate execution is disabled with gate.isolation_required; utility tests or receipts do not establish runtime containment.

candidates.role: Community explanations and worked native Claude examples
candidates.rationale: Keep as a source-linked reference for skills, subagents, commands and hooks; verify consequential claims against current primary Claude documentation. Its weather/presentation workflows are demonstrations, not evidence for this foundation.
candidates.installation_mechanism: Repository-specific .claude/agents, .claude/skills, commands and hook examples can be copied deliberately; this review selects no repository-wide configuration or hook installation.
candidates.activation_status: Source review only. No example workflow, model task, hook or service was executed.
limitations: README contributor tips, rankings and claims are not independent effectiveness measurements.
Repository CLAUDE.md configures work on that reference repository; it is not a global policy for this project.

candidates.role: Curated discovery links for Claude tools and practice
candidates.rationale: Use links to discover a specific missing capability, then inspect that project independently. Recency and listing position are not adoption evidence.
candidates.installation_mechanism: An informational curated list, not a runtime package. No list content, plugin set or linked repositories are installed.
limitations: LICENSE is CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 despite API SPDX NOASSERTION. This review links the list and records independent factual findings; it does not vendor or adapt the list.
Each linked implementation has its own license, security boundary and acceptance requirements.

candidates.rationale: Consider one named role only when a real task lacks a useful role contract. The accepted owned native worker remains the baseline; do not install a category catalog to increase apparent coverage.
candidates.installation_mechanism: Upstream supports category plugins or copying a selected role file to .claude/agents or the user agents directory. No role is installed by this review.
candidates.activation_status: Selected code-reviewer source reviewed, not executed.
limitations: The reviewed code-reviewer inherits the model but exposes Write/Edit/Bash as well as read tools; its title does not make it read-only.
Do not infer native multi-worker quality, best worker count, durable replay or cost improvement from prompt templates.

candidates.role: Discovery directory for specific MCP capability gaps
candidates.rationale: Use only to locate maintained primary implementations. Keep the already accepted scoped navigation, memory and browser integrations unless a representative task shows a gap.
candidates.installation_mechanism: Informational directory with per-project setup links; it is not an instruction to register all listed servers.
limitations: New MCP registrations can widen authority and discovery context; directory inclusion does not establish safe configuration.
No listed server is newly installed, connected or benchmarked here.

selected_skills.name: search-first
selected_skills.native_registration: A SKILL.md inside the selected project or user skill directory; invoke through native skill discovery.
selected_skills.project_deployment_observed: Existing project Claude and shared copies both matched the selected upstream bytes before global activation. Preserve all project copies and customizations.
selected_skills.acceptance_boundary: File installation and native discovery can be checked separately; retrieval or task-quality improvement requires actual representative work.

selected_skills.native_registration: A SKILL.md inside the selected project or user skill directory; invoke through native skill discovery.
selected_skills.project_deployment_observed: Existing project Claude and shared copies both matched the selected upstream bytes before global activation. Preserve all project copies and customizations.
selected_skills.acceptance_boundary: File installation and native discovery can be checked separately; retrieval or task-quality improvement requires actual representative work.

layer_map.rationale: Retain native Codex/Claude accounts, model choices and session behavior. Read community explanations on demand; no new wrapper or global client replacement.
layer_map.acceptance_boundary: A newly selected skill must appear through actual native discovery; a repository recipe is not a client execution result.

layer_map.rationale: Select only search-first and iterative-retrieval as on-demand skills, preserving current project rules and copies. Retain other advice as reference.
layer_map.acceptance_boundary: The coordinator reports exact global file installation; native runtime discovery remains pending review. Canonical project authority overrides generic repeat checks, fixed coverage thresholds and approval examples.

layer_map.rationale: Keep the accepted owned native child and bounded coordinator pattern; use iterative retrieval for a demonstrated missing-context problem.
layer_map.acceptance_boundary: Role-template breadth does not prove multi-worker task quality, provider budget enforcement or distributed replay.

layer_map.rationale: Keep actual worktree and OS boundary receipts. Do not adopt community hook/role prose as a security boundary.
layer_map.acceptance_boundary: An inherited model or read-only-sounding role can still expose write tools; qualify changed effects and permissions.

layer_map.rationale: Use exact/structural/scoped semantic incumbents; search-first finds an existing implementation before custom glue.
layer_map.acceptance_boundary: Select a new server only for an actual language or indexing gap; do not register a directory wholesale.

layer_map.rationale: Use the selected iterative-retrieval guidance for relevant missing-source queries while retaining scoped QMD and its recorded misses.
layer_map.acceptance_boundary: The bounded three-cycle recipe is guidance, not a new ranker or proof that the four retained benchmark misses are fixed.

layer_map.rationale: Retain accepted SocratiCode/Qdrant/embedding state and recovery; use discovery only when the selected workload exposes a gap.
layer_map.acceptance_boundary: No community listing establishes embedding quality, GPU compatibility or arbitrary-corpus retrieval.

layer_map.rationale: Keep ai-memory as the cross-harness memory of record. Omit automatic community learning/memory hooks from this change.
layer_map.acceptance_boundary: Avoid parallel durable stores and implicit capture; existing scope, deletion and recovery evidence remains authoritative.

layer_map.rationale: Retain native Tavily Search/Extract and browser/source checks; use lists only for discovery, then inspect primary sources.
layer_map.acceptance_boundary: Search and extraction success is source access, not research correctness or a consensus ranking.

layer_map.rationale: Keep on-demand guidance and the accepted context lanes; avoid loading whole skill/role inventories.
layer_map.acceptance_boundary: Selected file sizes are recorded, but token savings, cache effects and complete task cost were not measured here.

layer_map.rationale: Retain deterministic upstream/project tests and independent review. Keep verification-loop/eval-harness as optional references, not automatic installations.
layer_map.acceptance_boundary: Task-specific oracles and actual returns matter; generic coverage targets, static warnings and disabled evaluator execution cannot certify a result.

layer_map.rationale: Keep the existing pinned CI, provenance and publication checks. Pin any selected skill files and retain their license/source hashes.
layer_map.acceptance_boundary: No community popularity or README benchmark substitutes for native CI, source integrity or supply-chain review.

layer_map.rationale: Keep accepted Dagu/systemd cancellation, continuation and guest-reboot recipes. Omit perpetual community loops and category orchestrators from this change.
layer_map.acceptance_boundary: No source review here establishes provider cancellation, distributed scheduling or durable external effects.

layer_map.rationale: Reuse accepted local services and scoped deployment recipes; no community example warrants a new standing service.
layer_map.acceptance_boundary: Production authentication, a new host and independent application recovery still require their relevant evidence.

layer_map.rationale: Keep native resume, application backup and Restic recovery recipes; community handoff advice is supplementary.
layer_map.acceptance_boundary: A skill prompt is not a native checkpoint or backup. Do not reopen accepted fixtures for a documentation refresh.

layer_map.rationale: Keep scoped native telemetry and current inference routes; dashboards, HUDs and provider wrappers remain separately qualified.
layer_map.acceptance_boundary: No new model/provider call, rendering acceptance, attribution improvement or cost claim is made.

retrieval_record.interpretation: The unavailable guessed community rules path is not claimed present. Direct official Markdown requests were refused; official-page extraction succeeded through a different supported access path. No failed retrieval is labeled execution acceptance.

activation_plan: The coordinator reports successful installation of the two exact skills through the official skill installer and their Claude symlinks. Retain separate native discovery/interactive results and independent review; installation alone is not task acceptance.
Preserve existing project copies/customizations, native models/accounts/permissions and canonical task-scoped rules.
Do not install the full ECC or VoltAgent plugin bundle, global hook/rule packs, community memory capture or executable eval framework for this selection.
limitations: This review is not a universal ranking, current consensus or proof of state-of-the-art performance.
Community lists are discovery sources. Every newly selected implementation needs its own license/source and task-specific native acceptance.
No model/provider/broker invocation, installation, live configuration edit or new native qualification trial was performed by this review.

Global file installation and matching hashes were reported by the coordinator; native runtime discovery remains pending review. Existing project deployment, global installation and actual task performance are separate observations.
Existing foundation acceptance and open-gap status are unchanged.
